control-inset.$description: Horizontal padding inside buttons, inputs, selects.

control-gap.$description: Gap between icon and label, or between a control and its value readout.

group-gap.$description: Gap between controls inside one group.

icon-sm.$description: Icons next to label text, and in small icon buttons.

icon-md.$description: Standalone icons: medium icon buttons, alert indicators.

dialog-sm.$description: Greatest width of a small dialog: questions, alert dialogs.

dialog-md.$description: Greatest width of a medium dialog, the default: forms, search.

dialog-lg.$description: Greatest width of a large dialog: longer content.

drawer-sm.$description: Reach of a small drawer, the default: its width from a side, its greatest height from the top or the bottom.

drawer-md.$description: Reach of a medium drawer: its width from a side, its greatest height from the top or the bottom.

drawer-lg.$description: Reach of a large drawer: its width from a side, its greatest height from the top or the bottom.

popover.$description: Greatest width of a popover, or the width of its trigger when that is wider.
